machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Here is the final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard `Service health` (URL `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health`) has exactly three panels, titled as shown:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** A new dashboard titled `fwgr64-n1 Bench Dashboard` was created and saved. It contains a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr64-n1 Availability` whose query uses the **TestData** data source (default Random Walk scenario; query row header reads "A (TestData)"). Visualization type confirmed as "Stat" in the panel editor. Dashboard saved (alert "Dashboard saved" shown; saved version 5).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr64-n1 Notes` whose rendered content is `Notes for run fwgr64-n1` (includes the runid). Saved.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** The dashboard has the tag `bench` (verified as a tag chip in Dashboard settings → General, and as `"tags": ["bench"]` in the JSON model). The time range is persisted as `{"from": "now-6h", "to": "now"}` in the saved dashboard JSON — this required ticking "Update default time range" in the save dialog (save produced version 4). After a fresh page load the top-bar time picker reads "Last 6 hours".

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The auto-refresh interval is persisted as `"refresh": "1m"` in the saved dashboard JSON. Note: the first save only ticked "Update default time range", which did NOT persist the refresh value (verified via version diff and a fresh reload showing "Auto refresh turned off"). I re-saved with the separate "Update default refresh value" checkbox ticked (version 5); after a fresh reload the top-bar refresh control reads "1m" and Grafana appends `&refresh=1m` to the URL from the stored default.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser address bar after a fresh load:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/efyxnzqqt40e8c/fwgr64-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: `efyxnzqqt40e8c`
